maya: FYI seeing persistent p95 tail spikes from eu-west dedicated slice-41 since ~03:10 UTC. spikes to ~800ms intermittently, baseline ~120ms. unsure if noisy neighbor or network. anyone on?
infra-bot: alert: noisy-slice signal triggered for slice-41. artifacts uploaded: http://internal/infra/logs/noise-2056789123.tar.gz :rotating_light:
 tj: can you grab a quick sample from telemetry? need GPU SM util, PCIe latency, NIC qdepth around the spike times.
maya: pasted short snippet from the window: `gpu_sm_util: [20, 95, 98, 25] pcie_latency_ms: [1.2, 12.5, 14.0, 1.1] nic_qdepth: [4, 128, 140, 3]` — looks highly correlated.
 sophia: yikes. pattern looks classic noisy-io tenant. propose signal-aggregation heuristic: if (gpu_sm > 80 AND pcie_latency_ms > 10 AND nic_qdepth > 100) for 3 samples -> mark noisy. then autotriage: divert new allocs and soft-cap heavy tenants. I can draft the rule.
 zach: +1. add a short cool-down window (30s) to avoid flapping. routing shim should prefer warm spare slices when noisy. e.g.: `route: prefer: slice-42 when slice-41.noisy; fallback_after: 30s`. also apply egress policer to avoid tail ripple.
 maya: canary plan (proposed): 1) enable detection rule in canary ring at 03:30 UTC 2) divert new allocs from slice-41 to slice-42 3) apply soft throttle to tenant `ml-bench` at 10rps 4) monitor p95 and kvcache hit-rate for 20m then revert. @sophia @zach ok to run 03:30?
 sophia: ok i'll open a PR for the detection rule + test vectors. rule proto (pseudo):
```
if consecutive_samples(3, (gpu_sm>80 && pcie_lat>10 && nic_q>100)) {
  mark_slice_noisy(slice_id)
  apply_routing_override(slice_id, prefer_spare=true)
}
```
 tj: i'll watch telemetry and set a temporary alert: p95 increase >10% over baseline within 5m. if no improvement in 15m we preempt batch jobs on slice-41.
 zach: i'll prep the routing shim change and egress policer tweak in eu-west canary. command i'll run: `infractl routes update --from slice-41 --prefer slice-42 --cooldown 30s --policy soft-cap`
 infra-bot: canary deploy started at 03:31 UTC; rule_id=r-2026-noise-agg-9. smoke logs: http://internal/infra/canary/r-2026-noise-agg-9/logs. monitoring hooks added.
 maya: thanks team — starting the canary now. will post quick status in 10m. :thumbsup:
